description: Each reference document should have a single, well-defined responsibility.

Guidelines:
Avoid duplicating content across documents.
Maintain one canonical source for each topic.
Link to canonical content instead of copying it.
Update documentation incrementally, not in large batches.
Keep links current when files are moved or renamed.
Prefer concise, maintainable documentation over lengthy walkthroughs.
